instruction: A shop sells 120 kg of apples at 3 euro per kg and 80 kg of pears at 4 euro per kg. It then pays 500 euro for rent. How much money in euro does it have left after paying rent? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
